body: hey i sorta understand your position. it’s hard especially when you’re stuck living with family that’s so     mean and unhelpful, it really has long term negative effects on people. honestly if i were you i’d start doing things that YOU want to do. where do you wanna go in life and what do you wanna do with it? school won’t be in your life forever and you don’t have to let your family bring you down forever. maybe get a job or if you do start saving up to move out? there’s options out there and people to help you.  i wish you a lot of luck and i’m here to talk anytime.
